properties.name: weakcrypto:config
properties.value: skill pq-crypto, 2 scouts, max iterations 400, build bbcd802706e4

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: pycryptodome ships a 3DES implementation in this runner's build. 3DES is classically broken (Sweet32/short block) and should be retired independent of the PQ timeline; no call site reaches it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-1/SHA-2 available in the shipped build via the transitive @ethereumjs dependency stack. The runner app code (runner.ts) makes no hash calls.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: RSA available in the shipped build. Quantum-unsafe (Shor), but nothing in this runner encrypts with RSA — no harvestable RSA ciphertext is produced.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDSA P-256 available in the shipped build alongside secp256k1/Ed25519/X25519 from the same package. Classically strong; quantum-unsafe — a schedule migration, not a harvesting risk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: HMAC (PQ-safe MAC) available in the akula client build; likely used for chain/auth internals. Grover-only exposure, no Shor risk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: AES available in the shipped build via pycryptodome. AES itself is PQ-safe (Grover halves key strength); no call site in the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: golang.org/x/crypto provides the extended Go crypto surface (scrypt, pbkdf2, sha3, chacha20poly1305, ed25519, secp256k1-era ecdsa) to the embedded go-ethereum client. Same logical asset as LIB-a2c61150 — linked.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the TLS stack of the embedded akula client is classical-only (ECDHE via ring's X25519/P-256). Harvestable traffic if the client opens remote RPC/peer sessions. rustls 0.2x has no hybrid X25519+ML-KEM support. Same logical asset as LIB-da9e9820 — linked.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: pycryptodome is the crypto provider in the py-evm runner's build — its keccak backend is exercised by the benchmark signing path; the 3DES/AES/RSA surfaces have no call site. Quantum-unsafe algorithms (RSA) ride along in the shipped wheel.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ring provides AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305, ECDH and ECDSA over P-256, Ed25519, and SHA-2 in the akula runner's build, as the primitive layer under rustls. ECDH/ECDSA surfaces are quantum-unsafe; no app call site reaches them from the runner CLI.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: golang.org/x/crypto provides extended crypto to the embedded go-ethereum client (scrypt, pbkdf2, sha3, chacha20poly1305, ed25519, secp256k1-era ecdsa). Linked to its algorithm-level twin object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: rustls 0.21.9 is the TLS provider of the embedded akula client; version offers no post-quantum or hybrid key-exchange groups — upgrade path is rustls ≥0.23 with X25519MLKEM768 when available. Linked to its protocol-level twin object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-256/SHA-512 hashing in the akula build. Hashes face only Grover (square-root) speedup — not urgent; CNSA 2.0 asks for 384-bit digests on national-security systems.
